panels.title: 🌍 Akquise, Länderportale & Herkunft (Woher kommen die Bergsteiger?)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.at%' THEN 'Österreich (zuugle.at)'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.de%' THEN 'Deutschland (zuugle.de)'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.ch%' THEN 'Schweiz (zuugle.ch)'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.it%' THEN 'Italien (zuugle.it)'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.si%' THEN 'Slowenien (zuugle.si)'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.fr%' THEN 'Frankreich (zuugle.fr)'
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%zuugle.li%' THEN 'Liechtenstein (zuugle.li)'
    ELSE 'Andere / Dev'
  END AS portal,
  COUNT(*) AS pageviews
FROM piwik_log_link_visit_action l
JOIN piwik_log_action a ON l.idaction_url = a.idaction
WHERE l.idsite = ${matomo_site_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(l.server_time)
  AND ('${city}' = 'All' OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%city=', '${city}', '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%/', '${city}', '%'))
GROUP BY portal
ORDER BY pageviews DESC

SELECT 
  CONCAT(v.location_city, ' (', UPPER(v.location_country), ')') AS herkunft_stadt,
  COUNT(*) AS besuche
FROM piwik_log_visit v
WHERE v.idsite = ${matomo_site_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(v.visit_first_action_time)
  AND v.location_city IS NOT NULL 
  AND v.location_city != ''
  AND ('${city}' = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM piwik_log_link_visit_action l2 JOIN piwik_log_action a2 ON l2.idaction_url = a2.idaction WHERE l2.idvisit = v.idvisit AND (a2.name LIKE CONCAT('%city=', '${city}', '%') OR a2.name LIKE CONCAT('%/', '${city}', '%'))))

ORDER BY besuche DESC

panels.description: Durchschnittliche Zeitdauer ab Website-Einstieg, bis der Nutzer zum ersten Mal eine Startstadt wählt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, v.visit_first_action_time, city_action.first_city_time)), 0), 0) AS time_to_city
FROM piwik_log_visit v
JOIN (
  SELECT l.idvisit, MIN(l.server_time) AS first_city_time
  FROM piwik_log_link_visit_action l
  JOIN piwik_log_action a ON l.idaction_url = a.idaction
  WHERE l.idsite = ${matomo_site_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(l.server_time)
    AND a.name LIKE '%city=%'
    AND ('${city}' = 'All' OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%city=', '${city}', '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%/', '${city}', '%'))
  GROUP BY l.idvisit
) city_action ON v.idvisit = city_action.idvisit
WHERE v.idsite = ${matomo_site_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(v.visit_first_action_time)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.name, 'city=', -1), '&', 1), '#', 1)) AS start_stadt,
  COUNT(*) AS aufrufe
FROM piwik_log_link_visit_action l
JOIN piwik_log_action a ON l.idaction_url = a.idaction

  AND $__timeFilter(l.server_time)

panels.description: Pivottabelle der meistaufgerufenen Touren (Zeilen = Tour-ID) aufgeschlüsselt nach den Ausgangsstädten (Spalten = Cities alphabetisch sortiert). Werte = Seitenaufrufe.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  CONCAT('Tour #', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.name, '/tour/', -1), '/', 1), '?', 1)) AS tour_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.name LIKE '%/tour/%/%' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.name, '/tour/', -1), '/', 2), '/', -1), '?', 1) NOT IN ('no-city', '') 
      THEN LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.name, '/tour/', -1), '/', 2), '/', -1), '?', 1))
    ELSE '(ohne Stadt)'
  END AS city,
  COUNT(*) AS pageviews
FROM piwik_log_link_visit_action l
JOIN piwik_log_action a ON l.idaction_url = a.idaction
WHERE l.idsite = ${matomo_site_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(l.server_time)
  AND a.type = 1
  AND a.name LIKE '%/tour/%'
  AND ('${city}' = 'All' OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%city=', '${city}', '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%/', '${city}', '%'))
GROUP BY tour_id, city
HAVING city NOT LIKE 'http%' AND LENGTH(city) <= 30
ORDER BY tour_id ASC, city ASC
